transcript:
MARTIN: See if you can see anything in through the cell windows. 

DAVID: Y'okay

[SFX: We hear David walk down the hallway and stop at a cell.]

DAVID: First cell... The window is pretty grimy... Hold on...

[SFX: We hear the window squeak as he wipes them with his hand.]

DAVID: Nothing much in here. Some shredded papers... Maybe newspaper. It's hard to tell--wait. I think... I think there's blood on the walls. Yeah... Yeah, it's definitely old blood. Looks like someone nicked an artery in here. Thick squirts. What the hell happened in here?


DAVID: Keep going? (PAUSE) OK, I'm just going to look through them all unless you tell me otherwise...



[SFX: We hear David'd footsteps. until he gets to the next cell and rubs the glass of the window to have a better look.]

DAVID: Cell 2. There seems to be grime on the other side of the window. I can't see a thing.



[SFX: Again we hear him walk a bit further and look in the window of the cell.]

DAVID: And this is the third. The window here is clear... Looking through, it looks as though the cot inside is pretty severely soiled. Or... No, it's burned. Jesus, it's like someone spontaneously combusted in the bed, but there are charred footsteps leading to it. Someone was on fire and... walked to the bed. Wait... the footsteps are out here too. They came from the next cell... The open one...

(short pause)

DAVID: Check it out?
